args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's what you should pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for tropical sun)
- Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, hat, water bottle for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and North Shore road trip)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, beaches, and cultural sites)
- Travel documents (ID, flight information, hotel reservations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket or umbrella (Hawaii weather can be unpredictable)
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (unless renting at Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Formal attire (optional, for nice dinners)
- Reusable water bottle
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers for electronic devices
- Beach bag

Special Items for Specific Activities:
- Spa day items (June 17): Bathing suit, flip-flops
- Luau (June 16): Consider Hawaiian-style shirt or dress
- Shopping day (June 19): Comfortable shopping shoes, extra bags

Don't forget to check airline baggage restrictions before packing!
